experiment: QNATIVE-2 natural-variable-question Boolean, answerability, evidence retrieval and extraction on the verified QASPER source projection
status: PROSPECTIVE_ARCHITECTURE_DEFERRED_TO_NATIVE2; no model may load before this file and its implementation are committed
basis: QNATIVE-1 verified train/dev projection and coverage are complete with independent reconstruction and retained failure evidence. This study tests the actual natural-variable-question endpoints the earlier literal-registry and intent-only NATIVE-1/NATIVE-2 lines did not cover. It is a source-native mechanism study, not a fresh-final, competitor or Pareto claim.

data.reader: Only neutral_qasper_native_compile.open_phase for train/dev; calibration/confirmation/final/unused stay sealed and unopened.
data.split: Reuse the frozen NATIVE-1 inner component split (fit/selection/calibration) computed from component_id; QASPER train only. DEV is development assessment, never a sealed final.

qasper.yes_no.target: Native per-annotation yes_no; gold is the filtered retained-annotation distribution, never population truth.

qasper.answerability.target: Exact complement of native unanswerable; null/absent never becomes a class.

qasper.evidence_retrieval.target: Exact-block evidence; all unmatched native evidence retained in the denominator.

qasper.extractive_answer.target: Exact substring spans; unmatched spans retained in the denominator.

data.serving: Exact source-only rendered state, original question (with the registered prefix for answerability/evidence), and source-only candidate catalogue. No gold, IDs, splits or annotations in model text.

model: Architecture is NOT selected here. It is chosen only after the registered NATIVE-2 intent study reports, from that measured evidence, and then frozen in an amendment before any QASPER model forward. No QASPER DEV outcome may select architecture.

bool: 15-bin ECE and equal-frequency adaptive ECE on retained-annotation targets
retrieval: Recall@1/@5/@10 over exactly resolvable evidence blocks
Support-conditioned accuracy reporting full/mixed/no-catalogue support separately
Unmatched native evidence kept in the denominator, never dropped
extraction: Exact-match and token-F1 over native spans
Unmatched spans reported, never silently excluded
metrics.calibration: Selective risk/coverage and confidence-correctness AUROC on retained-annotation targets, reported for every endpoint

statistics.unit: Input-only connected component (paper), never annotation or repeated question
statistics.intervals: Nominal descriptive95 percent; not a simultaneous family-wise or release gate
statistics.paired: Paired component-ratio bootstrap versus the frozen NATIVE-1 pooled reference where an endpoint overlaps

gates.custody: Exact projection and protocol identities and unchanged source database before any model load
gates.coverage: Every registered train/dev row; no cap, no dropped error
gates.projection: Independent reconstruction of every serving/IR/target byte and native denominator
gates.mechanism: Endpoint gates fixed in the amendment before execution, on held DEV, with the same controls
gates.claim: Development mechanism screens only; no sealed-final, competitor, many-axis, certificate, Pareto or shipping credit

resources.gpu: Serialized Modal GPU only; never local GPU

failure: Retain every failed receipt, partial capture and superseded output; fail closed on custody, schema, membership or type errors; fix implementation-only prospectively with unchanged membership and call semantics; never fabricate a passing endpoint.
next_branch: If a natural-variable-question endpoint shows a measured mechanism advantage over the frozen pooled reference, proceed to a separately preregistered many-axis transfer and long-document strata study. A negative result is retained and recorded as a negative, and the architecture question returns to the NATIVE-2 evidence.
